name: claujev
description: Jev (TypeSafe AI) as a second pair of eyes for Claude Code: request triage, command guard, rule review, final check, subagent routing and effort suggestion.

api_key.title: TypeSafe AI API key
api_key.description: Your Jev key from typesafe.ai. Stored in the system's secure storage.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language of the messages Claude receives and of the questions sent to Jev.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe only logs (start here and check the report); enforce lets Jev act on Claude; off disables every hook. A project's .claude/claujev.json can override it per hook.

triage.title: Request triage
triage.description: Classifies each request (question, small or large change, ambiguity, project area), gives Claude a hint and suggests an effort level. "mode" follows the Mode setting above; off turns this feature off even if a project config enables it.

command_guard.title: Command guard
command_guard.description: Asks for your confirmation before destructive or credential-touching shell commands. "mode" follows the Mode setting above; off turns this feature off even if a project config enables it.

rule_review.title: Rule review
rule_review.description: Checks every code edit against the built-in and project rules. "mode" follows the Mode setting above; off turns this feature off even if a project config enables it.

final_check.title: Final check
final_check.description: Before Claude finishes, checks that the request is complete, nothing is unfinished and verify passes. "mode" follows the Mode setting above; off turns this feature off even if a project config enables it.

subagent_routing.title: Subagent routing
subagent_routing.description: Sends simple subagent tasks to a smaller, faster model. "mode" follows the Mode setting above; off turns this feature off even if a project config enables it.

subagent_check.title: Subagent report check
subagent_check.description: Catches subagent reports that claim work the subagent never did. "mode" follows the Mode setting above; off turns this feature off even if a project config enables it.
